modules.title: Module 0 - Introduction

content_items.title: Introduction to the RCSWA Online Mindfulness Training Program

modules.description:
Welcome to the WA Medical Schools Online Mindfulness Program.

Watch this introduction from Dr Sarah Moore before you start Week 1.
modules.summary: Meet the program and learn how the eight weeks fit together before you begin.

modules.title: Module 1 - Body Scan
modules.description:
Hello everyone

Welcome to Week 1 of the WA Medical Schools Online Mindfulness Program.

You should now have received an email with a link to your intake survey. If you have not yet completed these surveys, please do so now.

Below is a link to the first teaching video on Multitasking and Mindfulness, plus a link to the guided mindfulness practice "Body Scan”. You will also receive the link to this guided practice via SMS each week day this week at 6:30am. Don’t forget to make a note of the days that you complete your mindfulness practice so that you can complete your weekly mindfulness feedback survey, which will be emailed to you at the end of the week.

I would also like to remind you to consider finding a Mindfulness buddy who you can check in with during the 8-week program. With your buddy, you can discuss your learnings, share your challenges, and support one another to keep up with your practice. If you would like assistance with finding a buddy, please email me and I would be happy to help.

Enjoy!

Warm regards

Dr Sarah Moore
modules.summary: Get oriented to the program and settle into a guided Body Scan practice.

modules.title: Module 8 - Mountain meditation
modules.description:
Good morning everyone

Welcome to Week 8 – the final week of the WA Medical Schools Online Mindfulness Program.

You should now have received and completed your weekly mindfulness practice survey via email. If you have not done this yet, please do so now.

Below is a link to the eighth teaching video on "eMindfulness", as well as link to the guided mindfulness practice "Mountain meditation".  You will also receive the guided practice via SMS each week day this week.  Don’t forget to keep a record of your practice so you can complete your feedback survey at the end of the week.

At the end of this week, you will also be prompted to fill out the surveys you completed before commencing the program.  You will also be emailed these surveys again in six-months time to assess any changes that have occurred or been maintained. Your timely completion of these surveys is much appreciated!

You will have ongoing access to all of the teaching videos and guided mediations for the rest of the year, so please feel free to access them as you like.

Just a final reminder to check in with your mindfulness buddy at some stage this week and reflect on your learnings from the past 8-weeks.

Enjoy!

Warm regards

Dr Sarah Moore
modules.summary: Wrap up the program with eMindfulness and a grounding Mountain Meditation.
